title: 第0007章 灵力枯竭的灵田空间妙用第0008章 百倍灵药生长炼气二层
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间

;;
陆青禾很是愤怒，对于他来说宗门奖励的丹药和灵石太过于重要了，没有丹药和灵石他将难以再进一步。
一股庞大的神识笼罩过来，陆青禾顿时如同坠入冰窟一样。
陆青禾从愤怒中清醒过来，咬牙回答：“师兄，是师弟记错了。”
压在陆青禾身上的灵识这才消失。
中年男子微笑道：“师弟，以后这样的错不能再犯了。”
陆青禾深吸口气：“师弟知道了，多谢师兄指教，师弟打扰了。”
说完陆青禾大步的离开事务殿，他怕自己忍不住出手。
周通看着离去的陆青禾，他也看到了陆青禾眼底的愤怒，他并不不放在心里。
一个杂役弟子难道能够翻天不成，没有足够的资源，一辈子都在炼气初期打滚，对他造不成任何的威胁。
他距离炼气后期只差一步之遥，到时候进入内门，就算宗门知道他在事务殿的所作所为也不会惩罚他。
陆青禾绝对不是唯一的受害者。
“一个五灵根的杂役弟子有什么资格享用灵药和灵石，还不如成就我无上大道。”
“还有那块次等灵田，已经快要枯竭，正好缺一个替死鬼应对宗门的调查。”
灵田，哪怕是次等灵田也是宗门的宝物，要不是出现特殊的情况怎么会让一个炼气一层的杂役弟子去管理。
陆青禾走出事务殿，他脸色瞬间变得阴沉，他心在滴血，对他来说一枚丹药和一枚灵石太过于重要了。
他体会到了修仙界的残酷，哪怕是太玄宗这样的宗门，竟然也会发生恃强凌弱私吞宗门奖励的事情。
他也想上报宗门，但是他只是一个小小的杂役弟子，根本没有资格见到宗门的长老。
再说他也不知道宗门会不会为了他一个五灵根杂役弟子惩罚外门弟子。
实力，要是他有足够的实力，要是他是外门弟子，中年男子怎么敢欺辱他。

陆青禾没有回杂役院，按照玉简的指示，用了半天的时间找到了任务灵田。。
眼前的灵田大约一亩，灵米已经播种完毕，他要做的是每天用灵水浇灌，不能让灵田遭受破坏。
灵米成熟期是一年，一亩灵田的灵米产量是千斤，只要在时间内交出千斤灵米，他就可以获得100宗门功德和两块灵石。
同时如果产量很高，超出千斤，那些灵米就完全属于自己。
这绝对是肥差，哪怕只是多出几斤，对杂役弟子来说都是难能可贵的修炼资源。
灵米不仅能够售卖获得灵石，哪怕是自己食用，都增加修为。
陆青禾不明白那中年师兄为什么会将这样的好事安排在他的头上，顿时对中年师兄的怨气少了不少。
陆青禾整理了一下，将灵田旁边的小木屋整理出来，他知道这一年他几乎不可能离开这里。
然后开始认真的阅读玉简，直到将玉简完全的看完毕，陆青禾已经知道怎么照顾灵田灵米的种植了。
要注意三个方面，一个是浇灌，每天进行一次浇灌。
其次是除草，在灵米生长的过程中会伴随一种杂草，必须在第一时间清理掉，不然会影响灵米的产量。
最重要的是虫害，灵米最担心是虫害，一旦出现虫害，几乎都是血本无归，毁于一旦。

Lu Qinghe was very angry. For him, the elixirs and spiritual stones rewarded by the sect were too important. Without the elixirs and spiritual stones, it would be difficult for him to go further.
A huge spiritual consciousness enveloped him, and Lu Qinghe suddenly felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
Lu Qinghe woke up from his anger, gritted his teeth and replied: "Senior brother, it was my junior brother who remembered it wrong."
Only then did the spiritual consciousness pressing on Lu Qinghe disappear.
The middle-aged man smiled and said: "Junior brother, you can't make such a mistake again in the future."
Lu Qinghe took a deep breath: "Junior brother, I understand. Thank you for your advice. Junior brother, I'm sorry for disturbing you."
After speaking, Lu Qinghe strode out of the affairs hall, fearing that he could not help but take action.
Zhou Tong looked at Lu Qinghe who was leaving. He also saw the anger in Lu Qinghe's eyes, and he didn't take it personally.
How could a handyman disciple be able to overturn the world? Without enough resources, he would spend his entire life wallowing in the early stages of Qi refining, posing no threat to him.
He is only one step away from the late stage of Qi refining. When he enters the inner sect, even if the sect knows what he did in the affairs hall, he will not be punished.
Lu Qinghe is definitely not the only victim.
"What qualifications does a handyman disciple with five spiritual roots have to enjoy spiritual medicine and spiritual stones? He might as well achieve my supreme path."
"And that second-level spiritual field is almost exhausted. We just need a scapegoat to deal with the sect's investigation."
The spiritual field, even the second-level spiritual field, is a treasure of the sect. If there were no special circumstances, why would it be managed by a handyman disciple at the first level of Qi Refining?
Lu Qinghe walked out of the affairs hall, his face instantly turned gloomy, his heart was bleeding, a pill and a spirit stone were too important to him.
He realized how cruel the world of cultivating immortals was. Even a sect like Taixuan Sect would bully the weak and steal the sect's rewards.
He also wanted to report to the sect, but he was just a small handyman disciple and was not qualified to meet the elders of the sect.
Besides, he didn't know if the sect would punish the outer disciples for him, a handyman disciple with five spiritual roots.
Strength, if he had enough strength, if he was an outer disciple, how could the middle-aged man dare to bully him.
Lu Qinghe did not go back to the Miscellaneous Service Courtyard. Following the instructions of the jade slip, it took him half a day to find the mission spirit field. .
The spiritual field in front of him is about one acre, and the spiritual rice has been sown. What he has to do is to water it with spiritual water every day to prevent the spiritual field from being damaged.
The maturity period of spiritual rice is one year, and the output of one acre of spiritual rice is one thousand catties. As long as he hands over one thousand catties of spiritual rice within the time, he can obtain 100 sect merits and two spiritual stones.
At the same time, if the output is very high, exceeding a thousand catties, those spiritual rice belong to you completely.
This is definitely a fat difference, even if it is just a few extra pounds, it is a valuable training resource for the handyman disciples.
Not only can spiritual rice be sold to obtain spiritual stones, but even if it is eaten by oneself, it will increase one's cultivation level.
Lu Qinghe didn't understand why the middle-aged senior brother would arrange such a good thing for him, and his resentment towards the middle-aged senior brother suddenly disappeared a lot.
Lu Qinghe tidied up the cabin next to Lingtian. He knew that it would be almost impossible for him to leave here this year.
Then he began to read the jade slips carefully until he finished reading the jade slips. Lu Qinghe already knew how to take care of the planting of spiritual rice in the spiritual field.
There are three aspects to pay attention to. One is watering, watering once a day.
The second step is weeding. During the growth of Lingmi, there will be a kind of weed, which must be cleared away as soon as possible, otherwise it will affect the yield of Lingmi.
The most important thing is pests. Lingmi is most worried about pests. Once pests appear, almost everything will be lost and destroyed.
